title: My AI coach told me to back off

pip._note: Where your face sits in the twin video, as fractions of the frame. Used to crop the circle bubble shown over full-screen cards.

beats.say: Five days before my race, my AI coach told me to back off!
beats.caption: 5 days before my race, my AI coach told me to BACK OFF!

beats.say: Here's my setup. Garmin and Strava sync every ride into intervals dot I C U. It tracks fitness, fatigue and form.
beats.caption: Here's my setup. Garmin and Strava sync every ride into intervals.icu. It tracks fitness, fatigue and form.

beats.say: Then I plugged in an AI coach. It reads my power, heart rate and training load. Every single day!
beats.caption: Then I plugged in an AI coach. It reads my power, heart rate and training load. Every single day!

beats.say: This week? Seven hours. Two hundred and thirty nine K. Fitness seventy two, fatigue seventy seven, form minus five.
beats.caption: This week? 7 hours. 239 km. Fitness 72, fatigue 77, form minus 5.

beats.say: So the verdict? Keep it light, stay fresh! Hold back now, and I hit race day at plus fourteen form. Right in the sweet spot.
beats.caption: So the verdict? Keep it light, stay fresh! Hold back now and I hit race day at +14 form. Right in the sweet spot.

beats.say: And it's working! My one hour power is up four percent in three months.
beats.caption: And it's working! My 1-hour power is up 4% in three months.
